main: 2) Install SmapIt in a Stardew Valley folder.
3) Uninstall SmapIt from a Stardew Valley folder.

select_directory: [darkyellow]Enter the Stardew Valley installation directory where you want to install SmapIt.
fix_directory: [red]It looks like SmapIt is already installed in this directory, but some files are missing.
[darkyellow]Would you like to try installing anyway to attempt a fix?
fix_directorysteam: [red]It looks like SmapIt is already installed in the Steam directory, but some files are missing.
[darkyellow]Would you like to try installing anyway to attempt a fix?
invalid_directory: [red]Invalid directory or SmapIt is already installed.
found_steam: [darkyellow]A Stardew Valley installation was found in the Steam games folder. Install here?
github_not_available: [red]Failed to download SMAPI: GitHub is not available. Check your internet connection.
smapi_error: [red]An error occurred while trying to download SMAPI. Try again later.
smapit_selectname: [darkyellow]Choose a name for this SmapIt installation:
smapit_selectnamesteam: [darkyellow]Choose a name for the SmapIt Steam installation.
smapit_nametaken: [red]This name is already in use. Choose another one.
smapit_path: [yellow]If you're using Steam, add this launch option to your game: [darkyellow]"{smapitPath}" %command%
[yellow]If you're not using Steam, open the SmapIt shortcut in the game folder whenever you want to play Stardew Valley.
smapit_error: [red]An error occurred while trying to install SmapIt:

select_installation: [darkyellow]Select a Stardew Valley installation to continue:
confirm: [red]Are you sure you want to uninstall SmapIt from this installation? [darkyellow]({installName} - {installDir})
success: [green]SmapIt was successfully uninstalled from this installation.

restart: [yellow]You may need to restart SmapIt for changes to take effect.
confirm: [darkyellow]Are you sure you want to change this setting?

invalid_choice: [red]Invalid choice. Enter the installation number, not the directory or name.
smapi_not_found: [red]SMAPI file not found in this installation. Try reinstalling SmapIt or SMAPI.
smapit_updated: [green]The latest version of SmapIt is already installed.
smapit_avaiable: [yellow]A new version of SmapIt is available ({version} -> {newVersion}).
already_running: [red]SMAPI is already running. To start again, close the game and SMAPI first.
smapi_warning: [yellow]SMAPI is taking longer than usual to start the game.
If you have many mods installed, this may be normal.
If not, try restarting the game.
smapi_closed: This usually happens when SMAPI encounters an error.
Try disabling the option to hide the SMAPI console or reinstall Stardew Valley.
invalid_smapi_path: [red]Error starting SMAPI: The provided path does not lead to StardewModdingAPI.exe
github_not_available: [red]Could not connect to GitHub servers. SMAPI and SmapIt cannot be updated.
smapi_updated: [green]The latest version of SMAPI is already installed.
error_start: [red]An error occurred while starting the game.
success: [yellow]This window will automatically close when Stardew Valley launches.
